summary: Tested 4 critical mobile UI bug fixes on BidVex auction marketplace. All major fixes verified working correctly.

issues: Submit Request button is not disabled when reason < 20 chars - validation happens on click instead of real-time. This is a minor UX issue, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1: MarketplacePage.js and LotsMarketplacePage.js correctly use 'hidden lg:block' for desktop sidebar and 'lg:hidden' for mobile trigger
FIX 2: MessagesPage.js correctly implements mobile-first responsive layout with showMobileConversations state
FIX 3: MultiItemListingDetailPage.js bid input uses 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2' for proper stacking on mobile
FIX 4: SellerDashboard.js handleSubmitDeletionRequest correctly includes Authorization Bearer token header
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile UI fixes tested at 390px, 768px, and 1280px viewports. All responsive breakpoints working correctly. Seller dashboard deletion request API includes auth headers.

FIX_1a_marketplace_mobile_390px.details: No horizontal scroll, desktop sidebar hidden, only 1 Filters button visible, items full width

FIX_1b_lots_mobile_390px.details: No horizontal scroll, desktop sidebar hidden, only 1 Filters button visible (no duplicates), items full width

FIX_1c_desktop_1280px.details: Desktop sidebar visible on both /marketplace and /lots, mobile filter trigger hidden

FIX_2a_messages_mobile_390px.details: Only conversation list visible, no split panel, no 'BidVex Pro-Connect' placeholder visible

FIX_2b_messages_tablet_768px.details: Both conversation list and chat panel visible side by side, 'BidVex Pro-Connect' placeholder visible

FIX_3a_lot_detail_mobile_390px.details: Bid input width 306px (full width), Place Bid button width 306px (full width), button height 48px (meets minimum), no horizontal scroll

FIX_4b_loading_spinner.details: Submit Request button shows loading state during API call (Loader2 spinner visible in code)

FIX_4c_button_disabled_validation.details: Button validation happens on click, not real-time. Button is not disabled when reason < 20 chars, but error toast shows on submit.
